author_profile.short_bio: Lilian Porto is a pharmacist (B.Pharm) and the founder of The Shop Curator. She turns published dietary guidance into clear, printable food lists.
author_profile.bio: Lilian Porto is a pharmacist (Bachelor of Pharmacy, 2015). During her hospital pharmacy residency in the public health system, she worked on patient access to high-cost medicines, which meant reading complex clinical requirements and explaining them clearly to patients and doctors. She founded The Shop Curator to do the same with diet: turn published guidance from health institutions into clear food lists that people can actually use in the kitchen and at the store.
